label: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, Monadology §§36–37: Adding prior or more detailed contingent reasons…
interpretation: Prose reading of Leibniz’s inferential step: the explanandum is the contingent sequence or connection, and further contingent detail renews the demand. The source draws an outside-the-series conclusion in the existing series statement. This record does not prove that every global or non-well-founded explanation is inadequate.
